# A pilot is not a permanent institution

Reviewed the repair cafe pilot against the budget and dates written last autumn. We can run six more sessions with the present team, not promise a weekly service. [[Repair ideas]] needs that decision in plain language. Sustaining a modest practice may be a better outcome than demonstrating growth we cannot support.
